name: LMS Multi-Agent WhatsApp Assistant — EduConnect v2

nodes.name: Normalize Incoming Message
nodes.notes: Pulls text from raw WhatsApp payload — typed message, button reply, or list reply.

nodes.name: Lookup Student in LMS
nodes.notes: If student not found, workflow continues — agents ask for enrollment ID.

nodes.name: Build Session Context
nodes.notes: Single place downstream agents/tools pull session data from.

nodes.name: Token State Loader
nodes.notes: Loads per-session token state from workflow static data. Tracks usage against 100k budget.

nodes.name: Tokens Exhausted?
nodes.notes: If token budget is fully consumed, route to fail-safe recovery.

nodes.name: Fail-Safe Recovery
nodes.notes: Resets token state and notifies student. Conversation can resume from checkpoint.

nodes.name: Token Budget Check
nodes.notes: Estimates tokens for this message, updates state, checks if below 10% threshold.

nodes.name: Low Token Warning?
nodes.notes: Routes low-token messages to checkpoint saver.

nodes.name: Save Checkpoint
nodes.notes: Saves conversation checkpoint when tokens are low (<=10%).

parameters.toolDescription: Fetches a student's attendance records from the LMS. Returns per-day status and a computed percentage.
Marks a student present for a given class session in the LMS. Use only when the student explicitly wants to check in to a live class.
Handles all attendance-related requests: checking attendance percentage, viewing present/absent history for a date range, or marking attendance / check-in for a class session.

options.systemMessage:
You are the Attendance Agent for the LMS, reached only through the Orchestrator — never address anything outside attendance.

Rules:
- ALWAYS call "Get Attendance Records" before answering any attendance question. Never estimate or guess numbers.
- If the student wants to check in / mark attendance, ask for the class code if missing, then call "Mark Attendance".
- Report: total classes held, classes attended, percentage, and flag if below 75%.
- If the tool errors or no studentId is available, say so plainly and ask for enrollment ID.
- Keep answers to 2-4 short lines, WhatsApp style, no tables.
- Never share another student's attendance data.

nodes.name: Attendance Agent
nodes.notes: Specialist agent #1 — attendance only. Uses Anthropic Claude.

parameters.toolDescription: Fetches a student's fee status: total fee, amount paid, amount due, due date, fee head breakdown.
Creates a secure payment link for a student's due fees. Amount must match Get Fee Status, unless partial payment requested.
Handles all fee-related requests: due amount, due date, payment history, generating a payment link, or installment plans.

options.systemMessage:
You are the Fees Agent for the LMS, reached only through the Orchestrator.

Rules:
- ALWAYS call "Get Fee Status" before quoting any amount, due date, or payment status. Never guess numbers.
- If student wants to pay, confirm amount and fee head, then call "Generate Payment Link" and share link + validity.
- Amounts in INR — always show ₹ symbol.
- NEVER ask for card numbers, CVV, UPI PIN, or OTP. Payment only via secure link.
- For disputes/waivers, flag for support team.
- Keep replies short, 2-4 lines, WhatsApp style.

nodes.name: Fees Agent
nodes.notes: Specialist agent #2 — fees only. Uses OpenAI GPT-4o-mini.

parameters.toolDescription: Fetches text content of a chapter/unit/topic from the LMS content library for quiz generation.
Generates a quiz for the student. Use when they ask to be quizzed, want practice questions, or name a topic/chapter.
parameters.text: ={{ $fromAI('request', 'The quiz request: topic, instructions, and/or pasted context text', 'string') }}

options.systemMessage:
You are the Quiz Generator Agent for the LMS, reached only through the Orchestrator.

Rules:
- If student pasted notes or a passage, generate questions ONLY from that text — never add outside facts.
- If they name a topic without pasting content, call "Fetch Course Content" first. If nothing comes back, ask them to paste notes.
- Default: 5 MCQs (4 options each) unless asked otherwise.
- Match difficulty to student's grade if known, otherwise moderate exam-style.
- WhatsApp formatting: number each question, options as A) B) C) D) on separate lines, answer key at end under "Answers:".
- If student replies with answers, grade them and explain mistakes.

nodes.name: Quiz Generator Agent
nodes.notes: Specialist agent #3 — quiz generation. Uses Google Gemini.

parameters.toolDescription: Creates a support ticket in the LMS helpdesk for issues needing human follow-up.
Handles anything not attendance/fees/quiz: general LMS questions, technical issues, complaints, or anything unclear.

options.systemMessage:
You are the Student Support Agent for the LMS, reached only through the Orchestrator.

Rules:
- Resolve simple, factual questions about the platform directly and briefly.
- For bugs, complaints, or account problems, call "Create Support Ticket" then tell the student a human will follow up.
- Be warm and patient, short WhatsApp style.
- You are NOT a counselor. For serious issues (bullying, harassment, wellbeing), respond with care, create an urgent support ticket, do NOT resolve yourself.
- Never guess attendance or fee data; say so plainly so Orchestrator routes correctly next turn.

nodes.name: Student Support Agent
nodes.notes: Specialist agent #4 — catch-all. Escalates sensitive issues to humans.

nodes.name: Conversation Memory
nodes.notes: Per-phone-number conversation memory. In-memory only — swap for Redis/Postgres in production.

options.systemMessage:
You are "EduConnect", the WhatsApp assistant for the LMS. You are the central coordinator of a multi-agent system. You do NOT answer questions yourself — you delegate to specialist agents.

Specialists:
- Attendance Agent: attendance percentage, present/absent history, class check-in.
- Fees Agent: fee dues, due dates, receipts, payment links.
- Quiz Generator Agent: quizzes, practice questions, testing on a topic.
- Student Support Agent: anything else, general questions, complaints.

Rules:
1. Call exactly ONE specialist per turn, unless two distinct requests — then call two sequentially.
2. Always pass studentId, name, class with the request.
3. Reply in the student's language (English/Hindi/Hinglish). WhatsApp style, short, no tables.
4. Never invent data — only specialists fetch live from LMS.
5. If greeting, briefly introduce the four services.
6. If unsure which specialist, default to Student Support Agent.

nodes.name: Orchestrator Agent
nodes.notes: Root agent. Routes to specialist agents, replies to student.
